All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy of **v2.3.1** to production (unhealthy in all regions, 18% error rate).

**Action taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Reviewed deployment history: v2.2.9 (healthy), v2.3.0 (healthy), v2.3.1 (unhealthy). The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully (`rolled_out`).
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. (The first attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to avoid duplicates.)

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is back on v2.3.0, **healthy** in all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.

**Note:** The incident remains open for root-cause investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.
